policyDescriptions.match-visible: Random among exposed capsules with a colour on the currently reachable frontier; otherwise random. Build a ready bridge immediately.
policyDescriptions.leftmost-visible: Take the leftmost exposed capsule whose colour is reachable now; otherwise the leftmost capsule. Build the leftmost ready bridge.
policyDescriptions.smallest-visible: Choose the smallest exposed capsule of a reachable colour; random ties. No future search. Build a ready bridge immediately.
policyDescriptions.largest-visible: Choose the largest exposed capsule of a reachable colour, leftmost on ties; otherwise largest exposed capsule. Build the leftmost ready bridge. Deterministic, no future search.
policyDescriptions.prefer-release: Evaluate only the current automatic settle for each action. Prefer a win, avoid an immediate jam, then prefer more free slots and more cells cleared. No future search.
policyDescriptions.two-visible-then-random: For the first two capsule taps choose a reachable colour; then random legal taps. Build a ready bridge immediately.

limits: Single genre-experienced participant; not a population win-rate study.
Elapsed time is the HTML client reported active time, not pure thinking time or production game duration.
Occupancy is measured after automatic settle; immediate temporary allocation is not sustained pressure.
Policies use only information exposed in this fully visible pilot, but are not exact models of this participant.
Solver null means budget exhausted, never a proven loss.
